serviceArea: Ashford, Canterbury, Folkestone and the surrounding villages
audience: Homeowners with a fault or a rewire, and letting agents who need certificates turned around quickly

services.name: Emergency callout
services.description: Faults, loss of power and tripping circuits. We aim to be on site within two hours for calls placed before 4pm on a weekday.

services.name: Full and partial rewires
services.description: Rewiring of houses and flats, including consumer unit replacement and certification on completion.

services.name: EICR reports for landlords
services.description: Electrical Installation Condition Reports for rented property, with the certificate issued within three working days.

services.name: EV charger installation
services.description: Home charge point installation, including the notification to the district network operator.

services.name: Lighting and additional sockets
services.description: New circuits, outdoor lighting and additional sockets, chased in and made good.

differentiators: NICEIC approved contractor, so certificates are accepted by letting agents and insurers
We return free of charge if a fault we repaired recurs within twelve months
Two-hour target response on weekday emergency calls placed before 4pm
Every job is quoted in writing before work starts, and the price does not move
tone: Straightforward and practical. Sounds like a tradesperson who turns up when they say they will.
goals: Get emergency callouts phoned through rather than emailed
Win recurring EICR work from letting agents
Make the twelve-month return promise and the fixed quote obvious
